page.overview:
Who is Clown Nurse 5?

Big Clown Nurse, also referred to as Muscle Clown Nurse in the script, appears in "Another Way." She has a very masculine voice. It is implied that she kisses Jake's toe to heal it throughout the whole episode. She appears again in "Jake Suit" to heal Finn and Jake when they are in the hospital.

The Big Clown Nurse has light-green skin and heart tattoos on her arms. She wears a green dress and a nurse cap that has a heart stitched in the middle. She wears dark-green heels with light-green socks. She has a red nose, a blue mouth, and black hair.
